scenes.say: Every cafe gets these five guests. Which one came in today?

Number five asks what's good, then orders a drip coffee. Four, the latte with six changes. Three, the walk-in two minutes before close. Two, the phone order in the middle of the rush. And number one, the regular who brings friends.

props.caption: The *five* guests
items: The walk-in two minutes to close

scenes.say: I brought my sister today. Next week, her whole book club.
